description_en: Adds a binding relationship for an AXN extension number. The AXN extension number feature is similar to the AXN privacy number feature but introduces extension numbers to reduce the usage of X numbers. When making a call, the caller dials the X number first and then enters the corresponding extension number after hearing the prompt tone to be transferred to number A
description_zh: 添加AXN分机号的绑定关系。AXN分机号与AXN隐私号功能类似，AXN分机号在AXN基础上引入了分机号，从而降低X号码的使用量，在呼叫时候首先拨打X号码，听到提示音后输入对应分机号转接到A
name: BindAxnExtension

parameters.help_en:
The key of the number pool.

You can obtain the number pool key on the Number Pool Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m) page in the privacy protection console
parameters.help_zh:
号码池Key。

在号码隐私保护控制台，号码池管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m)页面获取号码池Key
parameters.name: pool_key

parameters.help_en:
The number A of the AXN extension number.
Number A can be a mobile phone number or a landline number. If it is a landline number, you must add the area code. Do not add a hyphen between the area code and the phone number
parameters.help_zh:
AXN分机号的A号码。
A号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话需要加区号，区号和号码中间不需要加连字符
parameters.name: phone_noa

parameters.help_en:
The extension number of number X. The extension number must be 1 to 3 digits in length.

If you specify an extension number, you must also specify number X. This means that both the Extension and PhoneNoX parameters must be specified
parameters.help_zh:
X号码的分机号码，1~3位。

如果指定分机号，必须同时指定X号码，即Extension、PhoneNoX两个字段必须同时被指定
parameters.name: extension

parameters.help_en:
The number B of the AXN extension number.

Number B can be a mobile phone number or a landline number. If it is a landline number, you must add the area code. Do not add a hyphen between the area code and the phone number.
When number A calls number X, the call is transferred to number B by default. If number B is not specified, the call cannot be connected.
When number A calls number X, the call is transferred to number B only when the callback mode for number A is set to default mode. If it is not set to default mode, the call cannot be connected.
To modify the callback mode for number A, go to Number Pool Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?resType=1) > filter by AXN extension number > Number Pool Management > Callback mode for number A > Modify Configuration.
To update number B, call the UpdateSubscription (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/pnp/developer-reference/api-dyplsapi-2017-05-25-updatesubscription) operation
parameters.help_zh:
AXN分机号的B号码。

B号码可设置为手机号码或固定电话，固定电话需要加区号，区号和号码中间不需要加连字符。
A号码拨打X号码时，默认会转接到B号码，如B号码未设置，则无法接通。
A号码拨打X号码时，A号码回拨模式为默认模式时，才会转接到B号码，若不是默认模式，则无法接通。
如需修改A号码回拨模式，在号码池管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?resType=1)>筛选AXN分机号>号池管理>A号码回拨模式>调整配置修改。
如需更新B号码，请调用UpdateSubscription (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnp/developer-reference/api-dyplsapi-2017-05-25-updatesubscription?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.i16)接口更新
parameters.name: phone_nob

parameters.help_en:
The number X of the AXN extension number.

Number X is a privacy number that you have purchased (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m) in the console.

If you do not specify number X, the system randomly assigns a number from the specified number pool as number X based on the ExpectCity parameter
parameters.help_zh:
AXN分机号的X号码。

X号码是您在控制台已购买的隐私号 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/numberbuy?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m)。

如果未指定X号码时，将根据参数ExpectCity从指定号码池中随机指定一个号码作为X号码
parameters.name: phone_nox

parameters.help_en:
The expiration time of the binding relationship. The time is accurate to seconds.
The expiration time must be at least 1 minute later than the current time
parameters.help_zh:
绑定关系的过期时间，时间单位精确到秒。
必须晚于当前时间1分钟以上
parameters.name: expiration

parameters.help_en:
The city where you want to select number X.

If no available numbers in the specified city exist in the current number pool, or if this parameter is not specified, the system randomly assigns a number from another city in the current number pool as number X.
If the number X allocation mode is set to strict match mode, the system returns an allocation error when no eligible numbers are available
parameters.help_zh:
指定城市进行X号码的选号。

如果当前号码池中没有该城市的可用号码，或未指定此参数，将从当前号码池中随机分配一个其他城市的号码作为X号码。
如果X号码分配模式配置为严格匹配模式，当符合条件的号码不存在时，系统会提示分配错误
parameters.name: expect_city

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to record all calls generated for this binding relationship. Valid values:

true: Records calls.
false: Does not record calls. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要针对该绑定关系产生的所有通话进行通话录音。取值：

true：录音。
false：不录音（默认值）
parameters.name: is_recording_enabled

parameters.help_en: The external business extension field. This parameter is returned in the call record receipt message
parameters.help_zh: 外部业务扩展字段，通话记录回执消息中会回传此参数
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en:
Resets the number display logic in the binding relationship. Set the value to 1, which indicates that the intermediate number X is displayed for both the caller and the callee.

Due to carrier regulatory restrictions, the setting to display the real number during a call does not take effect
parameters.help_zh:
重置绑定关系中的号码显示逻辑。固定取值：1（主被叫显示中间号码X）。

由于运营商监管限制，呼叫时显示真实号码的设置不生效
parameters.name: call_display_type

parameters.help_en:
The Settings for the corporate ringback tone for dial-up to number X after the AXN extension number is attached.

Specify the ringback tone field and ringback tone encoding for this parameter.

Valid values for the ringback tone field:
AXNRing_AB: The ringback tone Settings before the dial-up from number A to number X is connected (with a callback number) in the AXN extension number.
AXNRing_A: The ringback tone Settings before the dial-up from number A to number X is connected (without a callback number) in the AXN extension number.
AXNRing_N: The ringback tone Settings before the dial-up from number N to number X is connected in the AXN extension number.
AXNRing_A_PICKUP: The ringback tone Settings after the dial-up from number A to number X is connected in the AXN extension number.
AXNRing_N_PICKUP: The ringback tone Settings after the dial-up from number N to number X is connected in the AXN extension number.

Ringback tone encoding:

You can obtain the corporate ringback tone encoding on the Corporate Ringback Tone Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool/ringtone?resType=1) page in the privacy protection console.

Example:

To set the ringback tone before the dial-up from number A to number X is connected (without a callback number), enter "AXNRing_A": "1000****1"
parameters.help_zh:
设置AXN分机号在号码绑定后，拨打X号码的企业彩铃。

此参数请填写铃音字段和彩铃编码。

铃音字段取值：
AXN分机号中，A号码打X接通前的铃音设置（有回拨号码）：AXNRing_AB
AXN分机号中，A号码打X接通前的铃音设置（无回拨号码）：AXNRing_A
AXN分机号中，N侧号码打X接通前的铃音设置：AXNRing_N
AXN分机号中，A号码打X接通后的铃音设置：AXNRing_A_PICKUP
AXN分机号中，N号码打X接通后的铃音设置：AXNRing_N_PICKUP

彩铃编码：

在号码隐私保护控制台企业彩铃管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool/ringtone?resType=1)页面获取企业彩铃编码。

填写示例：

如设置A号码拨打X接通前的铃音（无回拨号码），填写："AXNRing_A": "1000****1"
parameters.name: ring_config

parameters.help_en:
The ASR status. Valid values:

false: Disabled. This is the default value.
true: Enabled
parameters.help_zh:
ASR状态。取值：

false：关闭（默认值）
true：开启
parameters.name: asr_status

parameters.help_en:
The ASR model ID. Valid values:

General-Telephone-Mandarin Chinese model ID: 7ee372834d2f4cc7ac0d0ab2d0ae1aac

General-Telephone-Cantonese model ID: 9b4afe3d224e4fa3bf963697113e2f77

General-Telephone-Regional accent model ID: 3655a6cb94764145a1f9a38a3c3b3b4b
parameters.help_zh:
ASR模型ID。取值：

通用-电话-中文普通话模型 ID：7ee372834d2f4cc7ac0d0ab2d0ae1aac

通用-电话-中文粤语模型 ID：9b4afe3d224e4fa3bf963697113e2f77

通用-电话-地方口音模型 ID：3655a6cb94764145a1f9a38a3c3b3b4b
parameters.name: asr_model_id

parameters.help_en:
The call restriction status. Valid values:

CONTROL_AX_DISABLE: Number A cannot call number X.
CONTROL_BX_DISABLE: Number B cannot call number X
parameters.help_zh:
通呼叫限制的状态。取值：

CONTROL_AX_DISABLE：A号码无法呼叫X号码。
CONTROL_BX_DISABLE：B号码无法呼叫X号码
parameters.name: call_restrict

A value of OK indicates that the request is successful.
For other error codes, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

SecretBindDTO.description_zh: 绑定成功后返回的结构体
